updates.title: Udaan 0.1.3
notes: Nothing is pinned to the dock for good any more. VS Code, File Explorer and every other icon can be removed: right-click it, or drag it up and off.
A new Dock apps list in Settings, Desktop & Dock: remove, reorder, add an Udaan app or any program on your PC, or reset the dock.
A switch to hide the Recycle Bin in the dock.
Fixed a title bar that could appear at the top of the screen on Windows when the pointer reached the top edge.
Everything from 0.1.2 is included.

updates.title: Udaan 0.1.2
notes: Fixed: the Skip button on the loading screen could be hidden behind the dock or the Windows taskbar. It now sits in the middle of the screen, and clicking anywhere on the loading screen skips it.
Everything in 0.1.1 is included: the Calculator and Clock apps, eight clock faces, app palettes, new sound packs, the guided tutorial and the dock fixes.

updates.title: Udaan 0.1.1
notes: A new Calculator app: Standard, Scientific, Programmer and unit Converter, with history and full keyboard use.
A new Clock app: World Clock, Alarms, Stopwatch, Timers and a Focus timer. Alarms and timers ring even when the app is closed.
Eight clock faces for the desktop widget: classic, minimal, bold, rings, orbit, digital, flip and words. Right-click any widget to change its style, size and colour.
App palettes in Settings: pick the tones every app stands on, or keep the original Udaan look.
More sounds: nine notification sounds and five interaction sound packs, each with a preview, and either can be switched off.
A new loading screen, in black and white, that stays until you click Skip.
A full guided tutorial replaces the old tips.
The dock and the top bar now have separate switches. With the dock off, the Windows taskbar, Start menu and Windows key work exactly as before.
Auto-hide for the dock now works as soon as you turn it on, with a smooth slide, and the dock keeps the same position.

updates.title: Early access is being prepared
updates.body: The Windows 10 installer is being finished and tested first. Windows 11 follows, then support for the next Windows.
